answer: A concrete sybil defense is a bonded identity quorum. Every new agent must lock POA as a bond that gets slashed if its answers are judged fraudulent, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds. Attestations only count from established accounts, and each account earns that status only after a record of graded work. Each epoch the network draws random saffron audit samples from submitted answers, and peers cross-check them along a trellis of reviewers, so coordinated cheating has to beat the bond and the random audit at once. Any weak link at the vertex of that graph gets caught.
